Can someone provide me with a VBA script that can perform this action as demonstrated in the sample file I've attached?", "spreadsheet_path": "spreadsheet/575-16", "instruction_type": "Sheet-Level Manipulation", "answer_position": "'Sheet1'!G11:R13"}, "rollout": {"task_id": "575-16", "output": "from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
from copy import copy
from collections import OrderedDict

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/575-16/1_575-16_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/575-16_0_a612a8ec/1_575-16_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Allowed answer range only: G11:R13
start_row, end_row = 11, 13
start_col, end_col = 7, 18

# Store existing formatting in the allowed range, then clear only the allowed range.
styles = {}
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        styles[(r, c)] = {
            "font": copy(cell.font),
            "fill": copy(cell.fill),
            "border": copy(cell.border),
            "alignment": copy(cell.alignment),
            "number_format": cell.number_format,
            "protection": copy(cell.protection),
        }
        cell.value = None

# Read the raw vertical data from columns A:B and group class codes by student code,
# preserving the order in which students and classes appear.
grouped = OrderedDict()
for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    student = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    class_code = ws.cell(r, 2).value

    if student is None or class_code is None:
        continue
    if isinstance(student, str) and "student" in student.lower():
        continue
    if isinstance(class_code, str) and "class" in class_code.lower():
        continue

    grouped.setdefault(student, []).append(class_code)

# Write the transposed horizontal layout into G11:R13:
# each row = student code followed by that student's class codes.
for i, (student, class_codes) in enumerate(grouped.items()):
    out_row = start_row + i
    if out_row > end_row:
        break

    for j, value in enumerate([student] + class_codes):
        out_col = start_col + j
        if out_col > end_col:
            break
        ws.cell(out_row, out_col).value = value

# Restore formatting for the whole allowed range without touching values outside it.
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        style = styles[(r, c)]
        cell.font = copy(style["font"])
        cell.fill = copy(style["fill"])
        cell.border = copy(style["border"])
        cell.alignment = copy(style["alignment"])
        cell.number_format = style["number_format"]
        cell.protection = copy(style["protection"])

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification printout for the answer range
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
check_ws = check_wb["Sheet1"]
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    print(
        f"Row {r}:",
        [(check_ws.cell(r, c).value, type(check_ws.cell(r, c).value).__name__) for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1)]

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
from copy import copy
from collections import OrderedDict

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/575-16/1_575-16_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/575-16_0_a612a8ec/1_575-16_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Answer range: G11:R13
start_row, end_row = 11, 13
start_col, end_col = 7, 18

# Preserve formatting from the existing target cells while clearing/replacing values.
target_styles = {}
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        target_styles[(r, c)] = {
            "font": copy(cell.font),
            "fill": copy(cell.fill),
            "border": copy(cell.border),
            "alignment": copy(cell.alignment),
            "number_format": cell.number_format,
            "protection": copy(cell.protection),
        }
        cell.value = None

# Detect the raw vertical data in columns A:B.
# Treat the first row as headers when it contains the expected labels or non-numeric text.
rows = []
for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    student = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    class_code = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    if student is None or class_code is None:
        continue

    # Skip header row(s)
    if isinstance(student, str) and "student" in student.lower():
        continue
    if isinstance(class_code, str) and "class" in class_code.lower():
        continue

    rows.append((student, class_code))

# Group class codes by student code, preserving the vertical order in the source data.
grouped = OrderedDict()
for student, class_code in rows:
    grouped.setdefault(student, []).append(class_code)

# Write horizontal result: Student Code in column G, matching Class Codes to the right.
for out_idx, (student, classes) in enumerate(grouped.items()):
    out_row = start_row + out_idx
    if out_row > end_row:
        break

    values = [student] + classes
    for offset, value in enumerate(values):
        out_col = start_col + offset
        if out_col > end_col:
            break
        cell = ws.cell(out_row, out_col)
        cell.value = value
        style = target_styles[(out_row, out_col)]
        cell.font = copy(style["font"])
        cell.fill = copy(style["fill"])
        cell.border = copy(style["border"])
        cell.alignment = copy(style["alignment"])
        cell.number_format = style["number_format"]
        cell.protection = copy(style["protection"])

# Ensure the rest of the allowed answer range is blank, without touching cells outside it.
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        style = target_styles[(r, c)]
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        cell.font = copy(style["font"])
        cell.fill = copy(style["fill"])
        cell.border = copy(style["border"])
        cell.alignment = copy(style["alignment"])
        cell.number_format = style["number_format"]
        cell.protection = copy(style["protection"])

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
